{{Top}}
{{Youmay|experts in operating [[Computer/Legends|computers]]|[[identity slicer]]s, who modified biological traits and genetic code}}
[[File:Slicer_TofG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A slicer working with a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]]]
{{Quote|Never use your pet's name as a password, Lord Vader.|A slicer|<ref name="AOD">{{SWGTCG|set=Agents of Deception|cardname=Unauthorized Access}}</ref>}}
A '''slicer''' was a computer expert, often self-taught, who excelled at working within a complex computer network, and could extract information from this network with great skill. Often, this information was secured by any number and manner of encryption and lockout systems, and a skilled slicer was able to circumvent these systems without triggering alarms.

Several members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]<ref name="itsc">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref> employed computer experts to write and slice code. While most code slicing could be performed by [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the "personal touch" was often required for special jobs.

==Equipment==
[[File:Freelance_Slicer_AWH.png|thumb|left|A Gran slicer at work]]
{{Quote|Good thing you didn't keep me waiting. I don't like to be kept waiting. If you had kept me waiting, I would have charged you triple overtime.|[[D/Crypt technician]]|<ref name="The Mandalorian Armor">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>}}
Simplest forms of slicing didn't require any special equipment; from almost any common computer terminal, knowledge of special codes and network routes allowed an experienced slicer to mount some signals and access records or camera feeds from distant parts. [[Juno Eclipse]], using the pilot console of the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'' was able to access systems of the ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]'' or encrypted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] records.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

When tampering with electronic systems, professional slicers used specialized computers and [[Electronic lock breaker/Legends|electronic lock breakers]], many built by the slicers themselves, to eke out a living in the digital world. These computers were carefully guarded and constantly modified and upgraded by the slicer, who rarely discussed its specs except with like-minded individuals. Complex access codes and even self-destruct mechanisms were often used to prevent a slicer's computer from falling into the wrong hands.

Many freelance slicers charged their clients for these "necessary" modifications as part of the requirements for the job in question.

==Identities==
[[File:Slicer-SWGamer5.jpg|thumb|right|A slicer at work]]
Slicers essentially had two, or sometimes more, identities. In place of their true identity, slicers generally used code names; even regular business associates would not know a slicer's true identity. Keeping their true identity a secret was very important to successful slicers; they would rather not have to spend their time evading law-enforcement personnel, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] with personal vendettas. Criminal slicers tended to use flashy pseudonyms, while government and corporate slicers often had militaristic code names or alphanumeric designations.

[[Socketguard]]s were specially designed to combat slicers.

[[Slicer droid/Legends|Slicer droids]] were intelligent automatons that excelled at sifting through mounds of useless data for the one needed fact.

One slicer went by the handle "[[Tiny F]]."<ref name="CompEncyc">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Identity slicers were forgers who specialized in altering the identity of their client. Going beyond providing new identification papers or [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] disguises, skilled identity slicers could alter one's genetic code or construct a perfect genetic duplicate, as [[Anomid]] identity slicer [[Dretcher]] did for the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Gault Rennow]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Identity Slicers}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A slicer or the verb slicing are all equal to the real-life term hacker or hacking, along with the stereotyped appearance.
